title: Pluto in Enhanced Color
explanation:
# Pluto's Hidden Rainbow

When NASA's New Horizons spacecraft zoomed past Pluto in 2015, it revealed a dwarf planet far more colorful and geologically diverse than anyone expected, with an enhanced-color image showing the famous heart-shaped region is actually made of two distinct materials—one side mysteriously smooth like freshly frozen plains, the other rougher and cratered. This icy world, located at the edge of our Solar System, sports a surprisingly young and active surface that contradicts its ancient age, proving that even the smallest planets in our cosmic neighborhood can harbor dramatic geological secrets.
